news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 10% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (15% operating cash flow to total debt). Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.72 loss per share (vs ₹0.84 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.72 loss per share (improved from ₹0.84 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹93.8m (up 6.2% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹5.41m (loss narrowed 14% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 109 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Chennai Meenakshi Multispeciality Hospital Ltd. Appoints M.S. Anantha Lakshmi As Company Secretary And Compliance Officer, Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: Chennai Meenakshi Multispeciality Hospital Ltd. based on the recommendations of Audit Committee and the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Board of Directors considered and approved the appointment of Ms. M.S. Anantha Lakshmi, B.Com., M.B.A., ACS., who is a member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ACS.46694) as the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company with effect from January 9, 2026 at a mopnthly remuneration of INR 0.125 millions (Gross) per month.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.20 (vs ₹0.90 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.20 (up from ₹0.90 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹98.1m (up 22% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.50m (up ₹8.24m from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.5% (up from net loss in 2Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 118 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
